title: Budget Southeast Asia — How to Travel on $30–50/Day: Thailand → Laos → Vietnam → Cambodia: The cheapest route through SE Asia’s greatest hits
description: A practical 21-day budget route through Southeast Asia’s four most affordable countries. Real costs from backpackers, street food guides, transport hacks, and money-saving tips that actually work. Hostels under $10, meals under $3, and unforgettable experiences for less than you’d spend on a week at home.

activities.name: Land at Suvarnabhumi or Don Mueang
activities.description: Take the Airport Rail Link to Phaya Thai (45 THB / ~$1.30) then BTS or taxi to Khao San area. Grab from the airport costs 200–350 THB ($6–10).
details: 💡 Don Mueang serves budget airlines (AirAsia, Nok Air) — often cheaper flights

activities.name: Settle In on Khao San Road
activities.description: Drop bags at your hostel ($5–8/night dorm), grab a Chang beer ($1.50), and wander. Khao San is THE backpacker hub — great for meeting people and booking onward transport.
details: 🏨 Budget pick: NapPark Hostel ($7/night) or Bed Station ($6/night)

activities.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew
activities.description: Arrive by 8:30 AM. Entry is 500 THB ($14) — the one splurge that's worth it. Temple of the Emerald Buddha is stunning. Dress code enforced: cover knees and shoulders.
details: 👗 Long pants and covered shoulders required (sarongs available to rent)

activities.name: Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha)
activities.description: 200 THB ($6) entry. 46-meter gold reclining Buddha. Get a Thai massage at the temple's school — 260 THB ($7.50) for 30-minute foot massage.
details: 💆 Wat Pho massage school is the birthplace of Thai massage

activities.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market or Night Bazaar
activities.description: Weekends: Chatuchak — 15,000+ stalls. BTS to Mo Chit. Weekdays: Rot Fai Train Night Market for food and vibes.
details: 🛒 Chatuchak tip: Coconut ice cream 30 THB ($0.85)

activities.name: Free Morning — Wat Arun
activities.description: Visit Wat Arun (100 THB/$3) across the river. Take the 4 THB ferry from Tha Tien pier. Explore the riverside area and pick up last-minute snacks for the train.
details: 🚢 Cross-river ferry is 4 THB ($0.12) — cheapest transport in Bangkok

activities.name: Overnight Sleeper Train to Chiang Mai
activities.description: Hua Lamphong Station. 2nd class sleeper: 791 THB ($22). Leaves ~6:30 PM, arrives 7:00 AM. Saves a night's accommodation AND is one of the best travel experiences in SE Asia.
details: 🎫 Book at 12go.asia or at the station 2–3 days ahead
🛏️ Bottom bunk costs more but worth it — more space and window

days.neighborhoods: Old City · Doi Suthep · Night Bazaar
days.title: Chiang Mai — Temples & Night Market

activities.name: Old City Temples
activities.description: Check into hostel ($4–6/night), rent a bicycle ($2/day), and temple-hop. Wat Chedi Luang, Wat Phra Singh, Wat Chiang Man — all free or 40 THB entry.
details: 🚲 Bicycles are perfect for the flat, compact Old City

activities.name: Doi Suthep Temple
activities.description: Songthaew from Old City: 60 THB ($1.70) shared. Entry: 30 THB. 306 steps up. Panoramic views of Chiang Mai.
details: 📸 Best light on the east terrace around 3 PM

activities.name: Sunday Walking Street or Night Bazaar
activities.description: Sunday Walking Street (Ratchadamnoen Rd) has food stalls, crafts, and live music. Other nights: Night Bazaar on Chang Klan Road. Budget: $5–10 for dinner + drinks.
details: 🌙 Sunday Walking Street runs 4 PM–midnight
tips: Chiang Mai is the cheapest major city in Thailand. A full day including hostel, three meals, temple entry, and transport can cost under $15.

activities.name: Thai Cooking Class
activities.description: Half-day class: 500–900 THB ($14–25). Includes market tour + 4–5 dishes you cook yourself — pad Thai, green curry, tom yum, mango sticky rice. Lunch included.
details: 👨‍🍳 Top-rated: Mama Noi and Thai Farm Cooking — book on Cookly.me

activities.name: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary (Optional Splurge)
activities.description: Elephant Nature Park: $40–80 half-day. Feed and observe rescued elephants — no riding. The one splurge everyone recommends in Chiang Mai.
details: ⚠️ NEVER ride elephants or visit places with shows — these involve abuse
💡 Budget alternative: Doi Inthanon National Park via scooter ($5 entry)

activities.name: Bus to Chiang Rai + White Temple
activities.description: Green Bus from Chiang Mai: 129–288 THB ($3.60–8), 3 hours. Visit Wat Rong Khun (White Temple) — a surreal all-white contemporary temple. Free entry (50 THB donation).
details: 🚌 Book at greenbus.co.th or show up at Arcade Bus Station

activities.name: Cross into Laos at Huay Xai
activities.description: Bus to Chiang Khong: 65 THB ($1.80), 1.5 hrs. Cross Friendship Bridge. Lao visa on arrival: $30–42 USD cash + passport photo. Sleep in Huay Xai ($5–8 guesthouse).
details: 🛂 Bring exact USD for Lao visa — terrible exchange for other currencies
📷 Bring 2 passport photos or pay $1–2 for photo service at the border

activities.name: Slow Boat Day 1: Huay Xai → Pakbeng
activities.description: The iconic two-day slow boat down the Mekong. Ticket: $11–14. Departs 11 AM. 7 hours through jungle-lined river with limestone karsts. Bring snacks, water, a book, and a cushion.
details: 🍺 Buy snacks and Beer Lao at pier before boarding — marked up onboard
💡 Sit on the left side for best views going downstream

activities.name: Pakbeng Overnight
activities.description: One-street river town for slow boat passengers. Guesthouses: $3–6. Walk up from the pier and pick one.
details: 🏨 No need to book ahead — just show up

activities.name: Slow Boat Day 2: Pakbeng → Luang Prabang
activities.description: Board by 9 AM. Another 7 hours. Scenery gets more dramatic — tall limestone cliffs, fishing villages, water buffalo. Arrive around 4–5 PM.
details: 📸 Best photo ops in the last 2 hours approaching Luang Prabang

activities.name: Luang Prabang Night Market
activities.description: Sisavangvong Road — handmade textiles, paper lanterns, and food stalls. Buffet dinner: 15,000 LAK ($0.75) for a heaped plate of Lao food.
details: 🛒 Tourist-priced but still incredibly cheap by any standard
tips: Luang Prabang is a UNESCO World Heritage city — the entire old town is preserved. One of the most beautiful small cities in Asia.

activities.name: Alms Giving Ceremony (Tak Bat)
activities.description: Watch as hundreds of monks collect alms at dawn (~5:30–6:30 AM). Sacred ceremony — stand back, stay quiet, no flash photography.
details: ⚠️ Tourist behavior has degraded this ceremony — be respectful and observe from distance

activities.name: Kuang Si Waterfalls
activities.description: Turquoise cascading falls 30 km south. Shared minivan: $2.50/person. Entry: 20,000 LAK ($1). Swim in natural pools. Bear rescue centre at entrance is free.
details: 🏊 Swimmable year-round, best Nov–Apr
🐻 Asiatic black bears rescued from bile farms — worth a stop

activities.name: Sunset from Phousi Hill
activities.description: 328 steps to the top. Entry: 20,000 LAK ($1). Views over the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers. Arrive 30 min before sunset.
details: 🌅 Arrive by 5 PM in April — sunset around 6 PM

activities.name: Minivan to Vang Vieng
activities.description: Minivan from Luang Prabang: $5.50–6.50, 5–6 hours on winding mountain roads. Take motion sickness pills. Arrive early afternoon.
details: 🤢 The road is VERY winding — seriously bring dramamine

activities.name: Blue Lagoons & Caves
activities.description: Rent a scooter ($7/day) and ride to Blue Lagoon 1 and 3. Entry: 10,000 LAK ($0.50) each. Crystal-clear swimming. Tham Phu Kham cave at Lagoon 1 has a reclining Buddha.
details: 🏊 Blue Lagoon 3 is less crowded — locals' favorite

activities.name: River Tubing
activities.description: Float down the Nam Song River past karsts: 55,000 LAK ($2.75). Vang Vieng cleaned up its party reputation — now an adventure/nature destination.
details: 🌊 Safe and mellow — life jackets provided

activities.name: Bus to Vientiane
activities.description: Minivan from Vang Vieng: 80,000–110,000 LAK ($4–5.50), 4 hours. Vientiane is the world's most low-key capital — feels more like a large town. COPE Visitor Centre (free) documents the impact of US bombing — powerful and important.
details: 🏛️ COPE is one of the most impactful free museums in SE Asia

activities.name: Pha That Luang & Patuxai
activities.description: Pha That Luang: Laos' most important monument — a gold-covered Buddhist stupa. Entry: 5,000 LAK ($0.25). Patuxai: Laos' Arc de Triomphe (built with US cement meant for an airport runway). Climb to the top: 3,000 LAK ($0.15).
details: 📸 Pha That Luang is most photogenic in late afternoon golden light

activities.name: Fly Vientiane → Hanoi
activities.description: Budget flights on VietJet or Lao Airlines: $40–80 one-way. 1-hour flight. Vietnam e-Visa ($25) should be pre-arranged. Alternatively, take the 24-hour bus ($25) if you're hardcore budget.
details: 🛂 Apply for Vietnam e-Visa at least 5 days before at evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn
✈️ VietJet Air often has $40 flash sales — check a week before

activities.name: Hanoi Old Quarter
activities.description: Check into a hostel in the Old Quarter ($4–6/night). Each street is named for what it traditionally sold — Silk Street, Silver Street, etc. Just wander. The chaos is the attraction.
details: 🏨 Budget hostels: Hanoi Downtown Backpackers or Old Quarter View Hostel ($4–6)

activities.name: Bia Hoi Corner & Street Food
activities.description: Sit on tiny plastic stools at the corner of Ta Hien and Luong Ngoc Quyen for bia hoi (fresh draft beer) — 5,000–10,000 VND ($0.20–0.40) per glass. The cheapest beer in the world. Pair with bún chả (grilled pork with noodles) from any nearby stall: $1–1.50.
details: 🍺 Bia hoi is brewed fresh daily with no preservatives — it's literally 20 cents a glass

days.neighborhoods: Ba Đình · French Quarter · Train Street
days.title: Hanoi — War History & Egg Coffee

activities.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum & One Pillar Pagoda
activities.description: Free entry but dress code enforced (no shorts/tanks). Open Tue–Thu, Sat–Sun, 7:30–10:30 AM only. See Uncle Ho preserved in a glass case. One Pillar Pagoda nearby is a quick stop.
details: ⏰ Arrive by 7:30 AM — lines get long fast
📵 No cameras inside the mausoleum

activities.name: Hỏa Lò Prison (Hanoi Hilton)
activities.description: Entry: 30,000 VND ($1.20). French colonial prison later used for American POWs. Fascinating and sobering. Senator John McCain's flight suit is on display.
details: 📚 Budget 1–1.5 hours here

activities.name: Train Street & Weekend Night Market
activities.description: Watch the train squeeze through a narrow residential alley (schedules posted — 3:30 PM and 7:30 PM are common). Then hit the Old Quarter Weekend Night Market (Fri–Sun evenings) for cheap clothes and street food.
details: 🚂 Train Street is touristy but genuinely wild — the train passes within arm's reach of cafe tables

days.neighborhoods: Ha Long Bay · Lan Ha Bay
days.title: Ha Long Bay Budget Cruise

activities.name: Budget Cruise to Ha Long Bay
activities.description: Book a 2-day/1-night cruise from Hanoi. Budget options: $60–100/person including transport, meals, kayaking, and cave visits. This is the one place you should spend more — the scenery is that good. 3,000 limestone karsts rising from emerald water.
details: 🚐 Most cruises include Hanoi pickup — departs ~7:30 AM, 3.5-hour drive
💡 Lan Ha Bay (Cat Ba Island side) is less crowded and equally stunning
⚠️ Avoid the absolute cheapest cruises ($40) — poor food and overcrowded boats

activities.name: Kayaking & Cave Exploration
activities.description: Most cruises include kayaking through karst lagoons and visiting Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave or similar. The kayaking is the highlight — paddling through arches into hidden lagoons.
details: 🛶 Kayaking is usually included — don't skip it

activities.name: Overnight on the Boat
activities.description: Sleep on the junk boat. Night squid fishing on deck (provided by crew). Stargazing in the middle of the bay. Dinner and breakfast included in the cruise price.
details: 🌌 No light pollution — incredible stargazing if the sky is clear

days.title: Ha Long Bay → Hanoi → Night Train to Huế

activities.name: Sunrise on the Bay & Return to Hanoi
activities.description: Wake for sunrise tai chi on the boat deck. Breakfast included. Cruise returns to port by 11 AM. Bus back to Hanoi by 2:30 PM.
details: 🌅 Set an alarm — Ha Long Bay sunrise is magical

activities.name: Free Afternoon in Hanoi
activities.description: Last chance for Hanoi street food. Get a bánh mì ($1), grab supplies for the overnight train. Pick up any souvenirs.
details: 🥖 Bánh mì is the perfect travel food — cheap, portable, delicious

activities.name: Overnight Train to Huế (Reunification Express)
activities.description: Hanoi → Huế on the Reunification Express. Soft sleeper (4-berth cabin): 600,000–800,000 VND ($24–32). Departs ~7 PM, arrives ~7 AM. One of Asia's great train journeys.
details: 🎫 Book at dsvn.vn or baolau.com — soft sleeper 4-berth is the sweet spot
🛏️ Bottom bunks are easier to get in/out of
tips: Vietnam's overnight trains are a budget traveler's best friend — you save on a hotel and wake up in a new city. The Reunification Express runs the full length of Vietnam.

activities.name: Imperial Citadel of Huế
activities.description: Entry: 200,000 VND ($8). Vietnam's Forbidden City — a massive walled complex of palaces, temples, and gardens. Heavily bombed in 1968 but being restored. Budget 2–3 hours.
details: 🏛️ The Citadel is enormous — grab a map at the entrance and focus on the highlights

activities.name: Royal Tombs (Khai Dinh or Minh Mang)
activities.description: Rent a scooter ($5/day) and ride to the royal tombs along the Perfume River. Khai Dinh: 150,000 VND ($6) — most ornate. Minh Mang: 150,000 VND — most scenic. Pick one if budget is tight.
details: 🛵 Scooter is the best way to reach the tombs — beautiful riverside ride

days.neighborhoods: Hải Vân Pass · Hội An Ancient Town
days.title: Huế to Hội An via Hải Vân Pass

activities.name: Motorbike the Hải Vân Pass
activities.description: The legendary mountain pass from Huế to Đà Nẵng — one of the most scenic roads in the world. Rent a scooter ($8–10 one-way drop-off) or hire a Grab bike ($15). 2–3 hours including stops. The Top Gear Vietnam Special drove this road.
details: 🏍️ Only do this if you're comfortable on a motorbike — the road has sharp switchbacks
💡 Alternative: Train from Huế to Đà Nẵng ($3, 2.5 hours) then bus to Hội An ($2)

activities.name: Arrive in Hội An Ancient Town
activities.description: UNESCO World Heritage town — a perfectly preserved 15th-century trading port. Japanese Bridge, Chinese assembly halls, and yellow-walled streets with silk lanterns. Old Town ticket: 120,000 VND ($5) covers 5 attractions.
details: 🏮 The town is car-free and best explored on foot or bicycle

activities.name: Lantern-Lit Old Town & Riverside Dining
activities.description: Hội An transforms at night — thousands of silk lanterns glow along the Thu Bồn River. Full moon nights (14th of lunar month) are especially magical with lantern releases. Sit riverside for dinner.
details: 🏮 Visit during or near the full moon for the Lantern Festival

days.neighborhoods: An Bàng Beach · Old Town · Central Market
days.title: Hội An — Beach, Tailors & Bánh Mì

activities.name: An Bàng Beach
activities.description: Cycle 4 km from Old Town to An Bàng Beach. Sunbeds and umbrella: free if you buy a drink ($1–2). Clean sand, warm water, way less crowded than Đà Nẵng.
details: 🚲 Bicycle rental: 30,000 VND ($1.20)/day from any hostel

activities.name: Get Clothes Tailored (Optional)
activities.description: Hội An is famous for custom tailoring — get a suit, dress, or coat made in 24–48 hours. Custom suit: $80–150 (vs. $500+ at home). Quality varies — read recent reviews and get fitting done early so you have time for adjustments.
details: ✂️ Top picks: Yaly Couture, BeBe Tailor, A Dong Silk
💡 Budget hack: get small items (shirts, dresses) that are harder to mess up — $15–30 each

activities.name: Central Market & Cooking Class
activities.description: Take a cooking class ($15–25) that starts at the Central Market. Learn to make cao lầu, bánh xèo (crispy pancake), and white rose dumplings. Includes dinner.
details: 👨‍🍳 Red Bridge or Thuan Tinh Island cooking classes are excellent

days.title: Fly to Siem Reap — Enter Cambodia

activities.name: Fly Đà Nẵng → Siem Reap
activities.description: Budget flights on VietJet or Cambodia Angkor Air: $40–80. 1.5-hour flight. Cambodia visa on arrival: $30 USD + passport photo. Alternatively, get an e-Visa ($36) in advance.
details: 🛂 Bring exact $30 USD cash for visa on arrival — they won't break large bills
📷 1 passport photo required

activities.name: Siem Reap Old Market & Pub Street
activities.description: Check into a hostel ($3–5/night — Cambodia has the cheapest hostels in SE Asia). Explore Psar Chas (Old Market) for spices, silks, and street food. Walk Pub Street for the backpacker scene.
details: 🏨 Budget: Onederz Hostel ($3) or Siem Reap Hostel ($4) — both excellent
🍺 $0.50 draft beers on Pub Street — yes, fifty cents

activities.name: Angkor Wat Sunrise
activities.description: Wake at 4:30 AM. Tuk-tuk to Angkor Wat: $2–3. The sunrise behind the five towers reflected in the moat is one of the most photographed scenes on earth. 1-day pass: $37, 3-day pass: $62. Get there by 5:15 AM for a good spot.
details: 📸 Best sunrise spot: the left (north) reflecting pool
🎫 Buy ticket the day before (after 5 PM) at the ticket office — it's valid from the next day AND you get a free sunset that evening

activities.name: Angkor Thom & Bayon Temple
activities.description: The walled city of Angkor Thom is as impressive as Angkor Wat. Bayon Temple has 216 massive stone faces — one of the most unique sights in the world. Also see the Terrace of the Elephants and Terrace of the Leper King.
details: 🗿 Bayon's faces are best photographed in morning light — the shadows create depth
🚶 Angkor Thom is large — tuk-tuk between sites saves energy

activities.name: Ta Prohm (Tomb Raider Temple)
activities.description: The temple where massive silk-cotton trees grow through the ruins — used as a filming location for Tomb Raider. Hauntingly beautiful and photogenic. Less restored than Angkor Wat, which is the appeal.
details: 🌳 The most photogenic tree-root spots have queues — patience pays off
💡 Visit after 2 PM when morning tour groups have left

activities.name: Sunset at Pre Rup or Phnom Bakheng
activities.description: Pre Rup is less crowded and equally beautiful for sunset. Phnom Bakheng is the popular choice but gets very packed. Return to Siem Reap — full-day tuk-tuk: $15–20.
details: 🌅 Pre Rup is the locals' sunset pick — way fewer people

activities.name: Tonlé Sap Floating Village (Optional)
activities.description: Boat tour of the floating village on Tonlé Sap lake: $20–30. Houses, schools, and markets all floating on the water. The Kampong Phluk stilted village is more authentic than the tourist-heavy Chong Kneas.
details: 🚤 Kampong Phluk > Chong Kneas — more authentic, fewer tourist traps
💡 Budget alternative: rent a bicycle ($2) and ride to the Angkor Centre for Conservation of Biodiversity (free)

activities.name: Last Shopping & Departure Prep
activities.description: Pick up last souvenirs at Made in Cambodia Market (artisan crafts). Pepper from Kampot ($3–5) makes a perfect gift. Massage on Pub Street: $5–7/hour for a full body massage.
details: 💆 $5 massages in Cambodia are some of the best value in the world
